company.name: Harborwick 3PL Ltd.
company.summary: Fictional 3PL/distribution warehouse: 6,000 m2, about 40 staff, two shifts, six zones A-F, electric MHE fleet.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklifts must not exceed 8 km/h inside the building.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklifts must not exceed 12 km/h in the outdoor yard.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklifts must slow to 5 km/h in marked pedestrian zones and crossings.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklifts must not exceed 5 km/h on dock ramps and leveller approaches.

facts.subject: pallet_stack
facts.statement: Free block-stacked pallets must not exceed 3.5 m in height.

facts.subject: pallet_stack
facts.statement: Free block-stacked pallets must not exceed 3 pallets high.

facts.subject: rack_bay
facts.statement: Each rack bay may carry at most 3,000 kg.

facts.subject: cold_zone
facts.statement: The cold zone must stay at or above +2 °C.

facts.subject: cold_zone
facts.statement: The cold zone must stay at or below +6 °C.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: No more than 3,000 kg of hazmat may be stored in the hazmat cage at one time.

facts.subject: main_aisle
facts.statement: Main transport aisles are 4.0 m wide.

facts.subject: storage_aisle
facts.statement: Rack storage aisles are 3.0 m wide.

facts.subject: pedestrian_walkway
facts.statement: Segregated pedestrian walkways are 1.2 m wide.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: Damaged-goods write-offs above 750 EUR need warehouse-manager approval.

facts.subject: zone_a
facts.statement: Zone A is the receiving zone: inbound docks 1-4, unloading and goods inspection.

facts.subject: zone_b
facts.statement: Zone B is the bulk storage zone: high-bay pallet racking.

facts.subject: zone_c
facts.statement: Zone C is the picking zone: ground-level pick faces and flow racks.

facts.subject: zone_d
facts.statement: Zone D is the dispatch zone: outbound staging in front of docks 5-8.

facts.subject: zone_e
facts.statement: Zone E is the cold zone: chilled storage held at +2 to +6 °C.

facts.subject: zone_f
facts.statement: Zone F holds the value-added services area.

facts.subject: warehouse
facts.statement: The warehouse floor covers 6,000 m2.

facts.subject: racking
facts.statement: The high-bay racking provides 2,400 pallet positions.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: The building has 8 dock doors.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: Dock doors 1-4 serve inbound receiving.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: Dock doors 5-8 serve outbound dispatch.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The hazmat cage inside Zone F covers 60 m2.

facts.subject: quarantine_area
facts.statement: The quarantine area is in Zone F.

facts.subject: returns_inspection
facts.statement: Returns are inspected in Zone F.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The hazmat cage is inside Zone F.

facts.subject: warehouse_manager
facts.value: Accountable for the whole site: operations, safety and final sign-offs.
facts.statement: The warehouse manager is accountable for the whole site: operations, safety and final sign-offs.

facts.subject: shift_supervisor
facts.value: Runs one shift: floor staff and incident response.
facts.statement: The shift supervisor runs one shift: floor staff and incident response.

facts.subject: forklift_operator
facts.value: Operates forklifts, reach trucks and pallet jacks.
facts.statement: Forklift operators operate forklifts, reach trucks and pallet jacks.

facts.subject: picker
facts.value: Picks customer orders in Zone C against scanner tasks.
facts.statement: Pickers pick customer orders in Zone C against scanner tasks.

facts.subject: inbound_operator
facts.value: Unloads, counts and inspects inbound goods in Zone A.
facts.statement: Inbound operators unload, count and inspect inbound goods in Zone A.

facts.subject: stock_controller
facts.value: Owns inventory accuracy: cycle counts, recounts and adjustments.
facts.statement: Stock controllers own inventory accuracy: cycle counts, recounts and adjustments.

facts.subject: returns_staff
facts.value: Inspects returns in Zone F and proposes restock, rework or scrap.
facts.statement: Returns staff inspect returns in Zone F and propose restock, rework or scrap.

facts.subject: maintenance_technician
facts.value: Maintains MHE, racking and dock equipment and logs all repairs.
facts.statement: The maintenance technician maintains MHE, racking and dock equipment and logs all repairs.

facts.subject: dispatcher
facts.value: Books transport, assigns dock doors and releases outbound loads.
facts.statement: Dispatchers book transport, assign dock doors and release outbound loads.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.statement: Only the warehouse manager may sign off stocktake results.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: The shift supervisor approves damaged-goods write-offs up to 750 EUR.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: The warehouse manager approves damaged-goods write-offs above 750 EUR.

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: The shift supervisor approves the final disposition of inspected returns.

facts.subject: overtime
facts.statement: Only the warehouse manager may approve overtime.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: The dispatcher assigns dock doors and time slots to carriers.

facts.subject: incidents
facts.statement: The shift supervisor reviews every incident report.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Only the warehouse manager may authorise new forklift operators.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-01 is titled Inbound receiving.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-02 is titled Put-away to storage.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-03 is titled Replenishment of pick faces.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-04 is titled Order picking.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-05 is titled Packing and labelling.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-06 is titled Outbound dispatch.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-07 is titled Returns handling.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-08 is titled Stocktaking and cycle counts.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-09 is titled Damaged-goods handling.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-10 is titled Forklift and MHE operation.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-11 is titled Pedestrian safety in the warehouse.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-12 is titled Cold-chain handling.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-13 is titled Hazmat handling and spill response.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-14 is titled Emergency evacuation.

facts.subject: procedure

facts.subject: ppe
facts.statement: High-visibility vests are mandatory for everyone on the warehouse floor.

facts.subject: ppe
facts.statement: Safety footwear class S3 is mandatory on the warehouse floor.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklift operators must wear seat belts whenever the truck is moving.

facts.subject: receiving
facts.statement: At receiving, the document check happens BEFORE unloading (PR-01).

facts.subject: receiving
facts.statement: Inbound goods are inspected BEFORE they are booked into the system (PR-01).

facts.subject: putaway
facts.statement: Goods are booked into the system BEFORE put-away to storage (PR-02).

facts.subject: picking
facts.statement: Pick faces are replenished BEFORE the picking shift starts (PR-03).

facts.subject: packing
facts.statement: Picked items are scan-verified BEFORE packing (PR-04, PR-05).

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: Returns are inspected BEFORE any restock, rework or scrap decision (PR-07).

facts.subject: stocktaking
facts.statement: A second count happens BEFORE any stock adjustment is posted (PR-08).

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: The daily forklift check happens BEFORE first use each day (PR-10).

facts.subject: evacuation
facts.statement: Roll call at the assembly point happens BEFORE anyone re-enters the building (PR-14).

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: The fleet has 9 electric counterbalance forklifts.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Counterbalance forklifts are rated at 3.0 t.

facts.subject: reach_truck
facts.statement: The fleet has 5 reach trucks for the high bays.

facts.subject: reach_truck
facts.statement: Reach trucks are rated at 2.0 t.

facts.subject: pallet_jack
facts.statement: The fleet has 11 electric pallet jacks.

facts.subject: pallet_jack
facts.statement: The site has 12 hand pallet jacks.

facts.subject: wrapper
facts.statement: Dispatch uses 2 semi-automatic stretch wrappers.

facts.subject: baler
facts.statement: The site has 1 cardboard baler.

facts.subject: dock
facts.statement: Each of the 8 dock doors has a dock leveller.

facts.subject: scanner
facts.statement: Pickers and inbound staff share 20 handheld WMS scanners.

facts.subject: shift_1
facts.statement: Shift 1 runs 06:00-14:00, Monday to Friday.

facts.subject: shift_2
facts.statement: Shift 2 runs 14:00-22:00, Monday to Friday.

facts.subject: cycle_count
facts.statement: Cycle counts run every working day on a rotating zone schedule.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.statement: A full wall-to-wall stocktake runs once a year.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Every forklift gets a documented pre-use check each day.

facts.subject: racking
facts.statement: Racking gets a documented safety inspection every month.

facts.subject: evacuation
facts.statement: An evacuation drill runs every quarter.

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: Returns are accepted within 14 days of delivery.

facts.subject: cold_zone
facts.statement: Cold-zone temperature is manually verified each shift.

facts.subject: pallet
facts.statement: A pallet, including its load, may weigh at most 800 kg.

facts.subject: trailer
facts.statement: Our contracted curtain-side trailers carry a payload of 26000 kg.

facts.subject: trailer
facts.statement: A trailer has 33 floor pallet positions.

facts.subject: van
facts.statement: Our delivery van carries a payload of 1800 kg.

facts.subject: van
facts.statement: The delivery van has 6 pallet positions.

facts.subject: outbound_door
facts.statement: Each outbound door handles 4 trailer loads per shift.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: There are 5 outbound dock doors.

facts.subject: trailer
facts.statement: A trailer takes at most 32 full-weight pallets (payload divided by maximum pallet weight, capped by floor positions).

facts.subject: van
facts.statement: The van takes at most 2 full-weight pallets; heavier orders go by trailer.

facts.subject: dispatch
facts.statement: Outbound capacity is at most 640 full-weight pallets per shift (doors x loads per shift x pallets per trailer).

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The hazmat cage holds at most 3 full-weight pallets (hazmat stock limit divided by maximum pallet weight).

facts.subject: handover
facts.statement: PR-15 End-of-shift handover must be conducted face-to-face on the warehouse floor (not by phone/message/note alone).

facts.subject: handover
facts.statement: Procedure PR-15 must be applied at every change of supervisor.

facts.subject: handover
facts.statement: The outgoing shift supervisor remains accountable until the incoming shift supervisor confirms acceptance of the handover.

facts.subject: handover
facts.statement: Both outgoing and incoming shift supervisors must sign the handover record.

facts.subject: handover
facts.statement: Handover briefing must be delivered in order: staffing/incidents, then cycle counts, then MHE availability, then cold zone.

facts.subject: unverified_picks
facts.statement: All unverified picks must be held inside Zone C until WMS verification passes and must not be moved to Zone D.

facts.subject: scan_verification
facts.statement: Scan verification for PR-04 orders must be performed by the picker who picked the order on their own picks, with no delegation.

facts.subject: scan_verification
facts.statement: Verification must be executed by scanning the order/tote barcode first, then scanning each item barcode individually.

facts.subject: persistent_scan_failure
facts.statement: Any persistent scan failure must be escalated to the shift supervisor and stock controller and the affected tote kept in Zone C.

facts.subject: packing
facts.statement: All packing for PR-05 must be performed in Zone D.

facts.subject: labelling
facts.statement: All labelling for PR-05 must be performed in Zone D.

facts.subject: wrapping
facts.statement: All wrapping of outbound pallets must be performed in Zone D.

facts.subject: stretch_wrapper
facts.statement: The 2 semi-automatic stretch wrappers used for dispatch are located in Zone D.

facts.subject: pr05_pr06
facts.statement: PR-05 Packing and labelling must be completed in full before any load is released under PR-06 Outbound dispatch.

facts.subject: outbound_pallet
facts.statement: Every outbound pallet must be stretch-wrapped prior to placement in outbound staging.

facts.subject: outbound_pallet
facts.statement: Door assignment for docks 5-8 must be confirmed before pallets are moved to the dock.

facts.subject: pr06_outbound_dispatch
facts.statement: All outbound movements under PR-06 Outbound dispatch are executed from Zone D.

facts.subject: vehicle_release
facts.statement: Trailer and van loads, door numbers and pallet counts must be recorded in the WMS before the vehicle is released.

facts.subject: overweight_pallet
facts.statement: Any overweight pallet or over-limit staging must be reported to the shift supervisor immediately.

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: All customer returns must be received in Zone A through dock doors 1-4 and must not be received in Zone D.

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: Inspected returns must be kept physically in Zone F until disposition is approved and posted in the WMS and must not be moved to bulk storage, picking or dispatch staging before approval.

facts.subject: hazmat_return
facts.statement: Any return marked hazmat, leaking or odorous must be segregated adjacent to the hazmat cage in Zone F for specialist assessment and not opened on the general inspection bench.

facts.subject: returns_exception
facts.statement: Any return that cannot be identified, is contaminated or presents a safety risk must be held in Zone F and the shift supervisor notified for instruction.

facts.subject: returns_inspection
facts.statement: Returns staff must execute PR-07 inspection in order: verify return against delivery and 14-day window, then open/count/examine condition, then photograph damage and retain labels, then propose restock/rework/scrap.

facts.subject: returns_handling
facts.statement: The inspection outcome must be recorded in the WMS before the physical return is moved from Zone F.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: All goods awaiting disposition under PR-09 Damaged-goods handling must be held in the quarantine area in Zone F.

facts.subject: rework_goods
facts.statement: Approved rework goods under PR-07/PR-09 must be routed to the designated work area in Zone F.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: For damaged-goods write-offs above 750 EUR the shift supervisor must endorse the request and forward it to the warehouse manager for final decision.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.statement: A stocktake recount must be assigned to a different counter than the first count.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.statement: The stock controller must verify the recount result before any adjustment is posted.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.statement: Counting teams must be independent from the stockholding area they normally operate.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.statement: The WMS/system must not be released for normal operations until the warehouse manager sign-off is recorded.

facts.subject: hazmat
facts.statement: Hazmat must be staged only inside the hazmat cage in Zone F.

facts.subject: cold_chain_affected_stock
facts.statement: Affected chilled stock subject to a temperature alarm must be held inside Zone E and tagged pending decision.

facts.subject: chilled_goods
facts.statement: Chilled goods must not be moved to another zone until the shift supervisor authorises release.

facts.subject: cold_zone_temperature_alarm
facts.statement: Any cold-zone temperature alarm or out-of-range reading must be notified to the shift supervisor without delay.

facts.subject: hazmat_spill_response
facts.statement: Spill response under PR-13 must be executed in order: stop work and alert, notify shift supervisor, ventilate and isolate, don PPE and deploy spill kit, contain/absorb/collect and log.

facts.subject: cold_chain_alarm_response
facts.statement: Cold-chain alarm response under PR-12 must be executed in order: recheck at calibrated display inside Zone E, keep doors closed/restrict entry, notify shift supervisor, hold and tag affected stock inside Zone E, do not move until shift supervisor authorises release.

facts.subject: assembly_point
facts.statement: The evacuation assembly point is at the north fence outside the building.

facts.subject: evacuation
facts.statement: Evacuation roll call at the assembly point is conducted by the shift supervisor.

facts.subject: evacuation
facts.statement: Re-entry after evacuation must be confirmed/authorised by the shift supervisor after building is declared safe.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: Damaged, leaking or suspected non-conforming stock must be moved to the quarantine area in Zone F on the same day it is identified.

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: Returns outside the 14-day acceptance window may only be accepted if the shift supervisor instructs otherwise.

facts.subject: scrap_stock
facts.statement: Scrap stock from returns must be held in the quarantine area in Zone F until approved for disposal.

facts.subject: dispatcher
facts.statement: The dispatcher must communicate door assignments to the shift supervisor, forklift operators and carriers before loading.

facts.subject: outbound_capacity
facts.statement: Adding trailer capacity beyond the 640 full-weight pallet per shift limit requires warehouse manager agreement.

facts.subject: pr06_outbound_dispatch
facts.statement: Under PR-06 order completeness and packing completion must be confirmed before a door is assigned.

facts.subject: pr06_outbound_dispatch
facts.statement: Under PR-06 a load may only be released after loading and door checks are complete.

facts.subject: handover
facts.statement: The dispatcher must participate in PR-15 End-of-shift handover with the outgoing and incoming shift supervisors.

facts.subject: pr04_order_picking
facts.statement: PR-04 Order picking must be executed in sequence: scan location, scan item, confirm quantity, place to tote/cart.

facts.subject: picking
facts.statement: If pick faces are incomplete or flagged as not replenished before PR-04, the picker must notify the shift supervisor and await replenishment.

facts.subject: overweight_pallet
facts.statement: Overweight pallets are weigh-checked and rejected or reworked in Zone A.

facts.subject: overweight_pallet
facts.statement: Overweight pallets must be weigh-checked and rejected or reworked before system booking.

facts.subject: inbound_non_conformance
facts.statement: The client must be notified of any non-conformance identified during inbound inspection.
